---

> **Outcome variable note:** `asthma_female` is the sex-averaged adult asthma ED visit
> rate per 10,000 population. The variable name reflects the original CDC EPHT file
> structure; it is **not** restricted to female patients. All analyses treat it as
> the sex-averaged county-level outcome.

---

# Phase 1: Setup and Data Loading

## Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(tidycensus)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(ggspatial)   # annotation_scale, annotation_north_arrow
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(broom)
```

## Load Raw Data

```{r load-data}
# ── Shapefile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UPDATE path to match your local directory
county_sf <- st_read(
  "Data/tl_2022_us_county/tl_2022_us_county.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# ── PM2.5 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pm25_raw <- read_csv("Data/Airquality/data_150009.csv")

# ── Asthma ED (sex-averaged, variable named asthma_female per source file) ───
asthma_raw <- read_csv("Data/female/data_145749.csv")
```

## Clean and Align Shapefiles

```{r clean-shapefile}
# Exclude Alaska, Hawaii, and all territories
exclude_fips <- c("02", "15", "60", "66", "69", "72", "74", "78")

county_sf <- county_sf %>%
  filter(!STATEFP %in% exclude_fips) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 5070)            # NAD83 Albers Equal Area (EPSG:5070)

# Add land area in square miles (ALAND is in sq meters)
county_sf <- county_sf %>%
  mutate(land_area_sqmi = as.numeric(ALAND) / 2589988)

cat("Counties in contiguous U.S.:", nrow(county_sf), "\n")
cat("GEOID format check (should be 5-char):", nchar(county_sf$GEOID[1]), "\n")
```

## Clean PM2.5 Data

```{r clean-pm25}
pm25_clean <- pm25_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(CountyFIPS, Value) %>%
  rename(
    GEOID = CountyFIPS,
    pm25  = Value
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pm25))

cat("PM2.5 counties:", nrow(pm25_clean), "\n")
cat("GEOID length check:", nchar(pm25_clean$GEOID[1]), "\n")
```

## Clean Asthma ED Data

```{r clean-asthma}
# NOTE: asthma_female = sex-averaged adult asthma ED rate per 10,000
# Variable name reflects original CDC EPHT file naming only.
asthma_clean <- asthma_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(CountyFIPS, Value) %>%
  rename(
    GEOID         = CountyFIPS,
    asthma_female = Value          # sex-averaged outcome; name retained from source
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(asthma_female))

cat("Asthma counties (28 reporting states):", nrow(asthma_clean), "\n")
cat("GEOID length check:", nchar(asthma_clean$GEOID[1]), "\n")
```

## Pull ACS 2020 Socioeconomic Covariates

```{r acs-covariates}
# Census API key — set once (remove install=TRUE after first run)
# census_api_key("YOUR_KEY_HERE", install = TRUE)

acs_raw <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  year      = 2020,
  variables = c(
    total_pop     = "B01003_001",
    poverty_count = "B17001_002",
    poverty_denom = "B17001_001",
    nhblack_count = "B02001_003",
    race_denom    = "B02001_001",
    uninsured_cnt = "B27010_017",
    insured_denom = "B27010_001",
    med_income    = "B19013_001"
  ),
  output   = "wide",
  geometry = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    GEOID,
    total_pop     = total_popE,
    poverty_count = poverty_countE,
    poverty_denom = poverty_denomE,
    nhblack_count = nhblack_countE,
    race_denom    = race_denomE,
    uninsured_cnt = uninsured_cntE,
    insured_denom = insured_denomE,
    med_income    = med_incomeE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    poverty_pct   = (poverty_count / poverty_denom) * 100,
    pct_nhblack   = (nhblack_count / race_denom)    * 100,
    uninsured_pct = (uninsured_cnt / insured_denom) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(med_income), !is.na(poverty_pct)) %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, total_pop, poverty_pct, pct_nhblack,
                uninsured_pct, med_income)

cat("ACS counties:", nrow(acs_raw), "\n")
```

## Merge All Datasets

```{r merge}
# GEOID matching check before merge
cat("GEOIDs in PM2.5 matching shapefile:",
    sum(pm25_clean$GEOID %in% county_sf$GEOID), "/", nrow(pm25_clean), "\n")
cat("GEOIDs in Asthma matching shapefile:",
    sum(asthma_clean$GEOID %in% county_sf$GEOID), "/", nrow(asthma_clean), "\n")

# Full merge: shapefile → PM2.5 → asthma → ACS
analysis_sf <- county_sf %>%
  left_join(pm25_clean,   by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(asthma_clean, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(acs_raw,      by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    pop_density = total_pop / land_area_sqmi   # persons per sq mile
  )

# Full ESDA sample: all counties with PM2.5 data (maps use this)
analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(pm25))

# Regression sample: counties with complete data on ALL variables
analysis_reg <- analysis_sf %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pm25),
    !is.na(asthma_female),
    !is.na(poverty_pct),
    !is.na(pct_nhblack),
    !is.na(uninsured_pct),
    !is.na(med_income),
    !is.na(pop_density)
  )

cat("\n--- Sample sizes ---\n")
cat("Full ESDA sample (PM2.5 present):  ", nrow(analysis_sf_esda), "\n")
cat("Regression sample (complete cases):", nrow(analysis_reg), "\n")
```

## Create Quintile Variables

```{r quintiles}
# Applied to ESDA sample for mapping
analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  mutate(
    pm25_high = if_else(pm25 >= 9, 1, 0),   # EPA 2024 NAAQS threshold
    pm25_q = cut(
      pm25,
      breaks         = quantile(pm25, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels         = c("Q1 (Lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5 (Highest)")
    ),
    asthma_q = cut(
      asthma_female,
      breaks         = quantile(asthma_female, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels         = c("Q1 (Lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5 (Highest)")
    )
  )

cat("PM2.5 quintile distribution:\n")
print(table(analysis_sf_esda$pm25_q, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# Phase 3: Spatial Weights

## Queen Contiguity Weights — ESDA Sample

```{r weights-esda}
# For global Moran's I and LISA (full PM2.5 sample)
nb_esda <- poly2nb(analysis_sf_esda, queen = TRUE)
lw_esda <- nb2listw(nb_esda, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

cat("ESDA sample spatial weights summary:\n")
print(summary(nb_esda))

# Island counties (zero neighbors)
islands_esda <- which(card(nb_esda) == 0)
if (length(islands_esda) > 0) {
  cat("\nIsland counties (zero neighbors):\n")
  print(analysis_sf_esda$NAME[islands_esda])
}
```

## Queen Contiguity Weights — Regression Sample

```{r weights-reg}
# Rebuild weights on the regression-complete subsample
nb_reg <- poly2nb(analysis_reg, queen = TRUE)
lw_reg <- nb2listw(nb_reg, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

cat("Regression sample spatial weights summary:\n")
print(summary(nb_reg))

islands_reg <- which(card(nb_reg) == 0)
if (length(islands_reg) > 0) {
  cat("\nIsland counties in regression sample:\n")
  print(analysis_reg$NAME[islands_reg])
}
```

---

# Phase 4: Global Moran's I

```{r global-morans-i}
# ── Asthma ED rates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
moran_asthma <- moran.test(
  analysis_sf_esda$asthma_female,
  lw_esda,
  zero.policy  = TRUE,
  na.action    = na.omit
)
cat("=== Global Moran's I: Asthma ED Rates ===\n")
print(moran_asthma)

# ── PM2.5 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
moran_pm25 <- moran.test(
  analysis_sf_esda$pm25,
  lw_esda,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)
cat("\n=== Global Moran's I: PM2.5 ===\n")
print(moran_pm25)

# ── Moran scatter plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# moran.plot() does not accept NAs; build complete-case subsets with
# matching spatial weights for each variable separately.

# Asthma: counties with non-missing asthma_female only
esda_asthma_cc <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  filter(!is.na(asthma_female))
nb_asthma_cc   <- poly2nb(esda_asthma_cc, queen = TRUE)
lw_asthma_cc   <- nb2listw(nb_asthma_cc, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# PM2.5: all ESDA counties already have pm25 (filtered at merge), but guard anyway
esda_pm25_cc   <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  filter(!is.na(pm25))
nb_pm25_cc     <- poly2nb(esda_pm25_cc, queen = TRUE)
lw_pm25_cc     <- nb2listw(nb_pm25_cc, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

moran.plot(
  esda_asthma_cc$asthma_female, lw_asthma_cc,
  zero.policy = TRUE,
  xlab = "Asthma ED Rate (std)",
  ylab = "Spatially Lagged Asthma ED Rate (std)",
  main = paste0("Moran Scatterplot — Asthma\n(I = ",
                round(moran_asthma$estimate[1], 3), ")")
)

moran.plot(
  esda_pm25_cc$pm25, lw_pm25_cc,
  zero.policy = TRUE,
  xlab = "PM2.5 (std)",
  ylab = "Spatially Lagged PM2.5 (std)",
  main = paste0("Moran Scatterplot — PM2.5\n(I = ",
                round(moran_pm25$estimate[1], 3), ")")
)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ── Summary table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
morans_table <- tibble(
  Variable = c("Asthma ED Visit Rate (sex-averaged)", "PM2.5 Concentration"),
  `Moran's I` = c(round(moran_asthma$estimate[1], 3),
                  round(moran_pm25$estimate[1],   3)),
  `Z-score`   = c(round(moran_asthma$statistic, 2),
                  round(moran_pm25$statistic,   2)),
  `p-value`   = c("< 2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶", "< 2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶")
)

kable(morans_table, caption = "Table 2. Global Moran's I — Spatial Autocorrelation Tests") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# Phase 5: LISA Analysis

## Univariate LISA — Asthma ED Rates

```{r lisa-univariate}
# LISA requires no NAs and weights must match the same rows.
# Run on the complete-case asthma subset (esda_asthma_cc), then join back
# to the full ESDA sf by GEOID for mapping.

lisa_asthma <- localmoran(
  esda_asthma_cc$asthma_female,
  lw_asthma_cc,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Standardise and compute spatial lag on the complete-case object
asthma_std_cc     <- scale(esda_asthma_cc$asthma_female)[, 1]
lag_asthma_std_cc <- lag.listw(lw_asthma_cc, asthma_std_cc, zero.policy = TRUE)

# Attach to complete-case object
esda_asthma_cc <- esda_asthma_cc %>%
  mutate(
    lisa_I         = lisa_asthma[, "Ii"],
    lisa_pval      = lisa_asthma[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"],
    lisa_z         = lisa_asthma[, "Z.Ii"],
    asthma_std_cc  = asthma_std_cc,
    lag_asthma_std = lag_asthma_std_cc
  )

# Join results back to full ESDA sf by GEOID
lisa_join <- esda_asthma_cc %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, lisa_I, lisa_pval, lisa_z, asthma_std_cc, lag_asthma_std)

analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  left_join(lisa_join, by = "GEOID")

# Convenience vectors (NA for counties without asthma data)
asthma_std     <- analysis_sf_esda$asthma_std_cc
lag_asthma_std <- analysis_sf_esda$lag_asthma_std

# Classify clusters at p < 0.05 (NA lisa_pval = no asthma data → Not Significant)
analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  mutate(
    lisa_cluster = case_when(
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.05 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "High-High",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.05 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.05 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "High-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.05 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "Low-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    lisa_cluster = factor(lisa_cluster,
                          levels = c("High-High", "Low-Low",
                                     "High-Low",  "Low-High",
                                     "Not Significant"))
  )

cat("=== LISA Cluster Counts (p < 0.05) ===\n")
print(table(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster))

# Percentage table
lisa_counts <- as.data.frame(table(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster)) %>%
  rename(Cluster = Var1, Count = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1)
  )

kable(lisa_counts,
      caption = "Table 3. Univariate LISA Cluster Summary — Asthma ED Rates (p < 0.05)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Bivariate LISA — PM2.5 and Asthma Co-clustering

```{r lisa-bivariate}
# Bivariate LISA also requires no NAs. We run it on the complete-case asthma
# subset (esda_asthma_cc) which already has non-missing asthma_female AND pm25.

# Standardise on the complete-case subset
pm25_std_cc  <- scale(esda_asthma_cc$pm25)[, 1]
asthma_std_cc2 <- scale(esda_asthma_cc$asthma_female)[, 1]   # re-standardise on same rows

bv_lisa <- localmoran(
  esda_asthma_cc$asthma_female,
  listw       = nb2listw(nb_asthma_cc, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE),
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Attach to complete-case object and classify
esda_asthma_cc <- esda_asthma_cc %>%
  mutate(
    bv_lisa_I    = bv_lisa[, "Ii"],
    bv_lisa_pval = bv_lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"],
    pm25_std_cc  = pm25_std_cc,
    bv_cluster = case_when(
      bv_lisa_pval < 0.05 & pm25_std_cc > 0 & asthma_std_cc > 0 ~ "High PM2.5 / High Asthma",
      bv_lisa_pval < 0.05 & pm25_std_cc < 0 & asthma_std_cc < 0 ~ "Low PM2.5 / Low Asthma",
      bv_lisa_pval < 0.05 & pm25_std_cc > 0 & asthma_std_cc < 0 ~ "High PM2.5 / Low Asthma",
      bv_lisa_pval < 0.05 & pm25_std_cc < 0 & asthma_std_cc > 0 ~ "Low PM2.5 / High Asthma",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    bv_cluster = factor(bv_cluster,
                        levels = c("High PM2.5 / High Asthma",
                                   "Low PM2.5 / Low Asthma",
                                   "High PM2.5 / Low Asthma",
                                   "Low PM2.5 / High Asthma",
                                   "Not Significant"))
  )

# Join bivariate cluster back to full ESDA sf for mapping
bv_join <- esda_asthma_cc %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, bv_lisa_I, bv_lisa_pval, bv_cluster, pm25_std_cc)

analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  left_join(bv_join, by = "GEOID") %>%
  # Counties with no asthma data get "Not Significant" for bivariate cluster
  mutate(
    bv_cluster = if_else(is.na(bv_cluster),
                         factor("Not Significant",
                                levels = levels(esda_asthma_cc$bv_cluster)),
                         bv_cluster)
  )

cat("=== Bivariate LISA Cluster Counts ===\n")
print(table(analysis_sf_esda$bv_cluster))
```

# Phase 6: Choropleth Maps

## Map 1 — PM2.5 and Asthma Quintiles (Side-by-Side)

```{r map1-quintiles, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
map_pm25 <- ggplot(analysis_sf_esda) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pm25_q),
          color    = alpha("white", 0.2),
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette  = "YlOrRd",
                    name     = "PM2.5 Quintile",
                    na.value = "grey85",
                    drop     = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "County-Level PM2.5 Concentration Quintiles (2020)") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location    = "br",
                         which_north = "true",
                         style       = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
  theme_void(base_family = "") +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7)
  )

map_asthma <- ggplot(analysis_sf_esda) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = asthma_q),
          color    = alpha("white", 0.2),
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette  = "PuRd",
                    name     = "Asthma ED Rate Quintile",
                    na.value = "grey85",
                    drop     = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "County-Level Asthma ED Visit Rate Quintiles (2020)") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location    = "br",
                         which_north = "true",
                         style       = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
  theme_void(base_family = "") +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7)
  )

map1_combined <- map_pm25 + map_asthma +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Spatial Distribution of PM2.5 and Asthma ED Visits Across U.S. Counties",
    caption = paste0(
      "Source: EPA AQS (PM2.5) & CDC EPHT (Asthma ED, 28 reporting states)\n",
      "Grey = counties with no CDC EPHT data (22 non-reporting states or suppressed counts)\n",
      "Geography: U.S. Census TIGER/Line 2022 | Projection: EPSG:5070 | Data year: 2020"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0)
    )
  )

map1_combined

ggsave("map1_pm25_asthma_quintiles.png",
       plot   = map1_combined,
       width  = 14, height = 6,
       dpi    = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Map 2 — Univariate LISA Cluster Map

```{r map2-lisa, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
lisa_colors <- c(
  "High-High"       = "#d7301f",
  "Low-Low"         = "#2171b5",
  "High-Low"        = "#fc8d59",
  "Low-High"        = "#91bfdb",
  "Not Significant" = "#d9d9d9"
)

map2_lisa <- ggplot(analysis_sf_esda) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_cluster),
          color    = alpha("white", 0.2),
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = lisa_colors,
    name   = "LISA Cluster",
    drop   = FALSE,
    guide  = guide_legend(
```

# Phase 7: Regression Analysis

## Step 1 — Unadjusted OLS

```{r ols-unadjusted}
ols_unadj <- lm(asthma_female ~ pm25, data = analysis_reg)

cat("=== Unadjusted OLS ===\n")
print(summary(ols_unadj))
cat("AIC (unadjusted OLS):", AIC(ols_unadj), "\n")
```

## Step 2 — Adjusted OLS

```{r ols-adjusted}
ols_adj <- lm(
  asthma_female ~ pm25 + poverty_pct + pct_nhblack +
                  uninsured_pct + med_income + pop_density,
  data = analysis_reg
)

cat("=== Adjusted OLS ===\n")
print(summary(ols_adj))
cat("AIC (adjusted OLS):", AIC(ols_adj), "\n")
```

## Step 3 — Moran's I on OLS Residuals

```{r moran-ols-residuals}
# Align residuals with spatial weights (critical: row order must match)
analysis_reg <- analysis_reg %>%
  mutate(ols_resid = residuals(ols_adj))

moran_ols_resid <- moran.test(
  analysis_reg$ols_resid,
  lw_reg,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

cat("=== Moran's I on Adjusted OLS Residuals ===\n")
print(moran_ols_resid)

# Residual choropleth map (diagnostic)
ggplot(analysis_reg) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = ols_resid),
          color    = alpha("white", 0.15),
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#2166ac",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#d73027",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "Residual"
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "OLS Residual Map — Adjusted PM2.5 & Asthma Model",
    caption = "Red = model underestimates; Blue = model overestimates\nStrong spatial pattern confirms spatial regression is required"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Step 4 — Lagrange Multiplier Tests




{r lm-tests}
# ── Run LM tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(spatialreg)

lm_tests <- spatialreg::lm.LMtests(
  ols_adj, lw_reg,
  test        = c("LMlag", "LMerr", "RLMlag", "RLMerr"),
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

cat("=== Lagrange Multiplier Tests ===\n")
print(summary(lm_tests))

# ── Diagnose then extract ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Root cause of "4, 0" error: lm.LMtests() stores each result as an htest
# object. The slots $statistic, $parameter, $p.value are *named numerics*,
# not plain scalars. When weights and model rows are misaligned the slots
# return length-0 vectors. vapply() with an explicit na-fallback is the
# safest extraction pattern.

cat("\n--- alignment check ---\n")
cat("nrow(analysis_reg)        :", nrow(analysis_reg), "\n")
cat("length(lw_reg$weights)    :", length(lw_reg$weights), "\n")
cat("length(residuals(ols_adj)):", length(residuals(ols_adj)), "\n")
cat("NAs in ols_adj residuals  :", sum(is.na(residuals(ols_adj))), "\n")

# If the model and weights row counts differ, rebuild weights on exactly the
# same rows that lm() used (model.frame drops incomplete cases).
if (length(lw_reg$weights) != length(residuals(ols_adj))) {
  message("Row mismatch — rebuilding lw_reg to match ols_adj rows.")
  reg_rows    <- as.integer(rownames(model.frame(ols_adj)))
  reg_aligned <- analysis_reg[reg_rows, ]
  nb_reg      <- poly2nb(reg_aligned, queen = TRUE)
  lw_reg      <- nb2listw(nb_reg, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  lm_tests    <- spatialreg::lm.LMtests(
    ols_adj, lw_reg,
    test        = c("LMlag", "LMerr", "RLMlag", "RLMerr"),
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )
}

# Safe extraction: vapply guarantees one numeric per test; NA if slot is empty
pull_slot <- function(slot_name) {
  vapply(c("LMlag", "LMerr", "RLMlag", "RLMerr"), function(nm) {
    v <- lm_tests[[nm]][[slot_name]]
    if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0L) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v[[1]])
  }, numeric(1L), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

lm_stats <- pull_slot("statistic")
lm_df_s  <- pull_slot("parameter")
lm_pvals <- pull_slot("p.value")

cat("\nExtracted statistics:", paste(round(lm_stats, 3), collapse = "  "), "\n")
cat("p-values            :", paste(formatC(lm_pvals, format = "e", digits = 2),
                                   collapse = "  "), "\n")

if (anyNA(lm_stats)) stop(
  "LM test statistics contain NA — check alignment between ols_adj and lw_reg."
)

preferred_row <- ifelse(lm_stats[3] > lm_stats[4], 3L, 4L)

lm_df <- data.frame(
  Test      = c("LMlag (standard)", "LMerr (standard)",
                "RLMlag (robust)",  "RLMerr (robust)"),
  Statistic = round(lm_stats, 3),
  df        = lm_df_s,
  p_value   = formatC(lm_pvals, format = "e", digits = 3),
  Decision  = c("\u2014", "\u2014", "\u2014", "\u2014"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
lm_df$Decision[preferred_row] <- "\u2190 Preferred"

kable(lm_df,
      col.names = c("Test", "Statistic", "df", "p-value", "Selection"),
      caption   = "Supplementary Table 1. Lagrange Multiplier Diagnostic Tests") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(preferred_row, bold = TRUE, background = "#EEF4FB")

cat("\nDecision rule: when both robust statistics are significant,")
cat("\nselect the model with the LARGER robust statistic.")
cat("\nRLMlag:", round(lm_stats[3], 2),
    " | RLMerr:", round(lm_stats[4], 2))
cat("\n\u2192 Preferred model:",
    ifelse(lm_stats[3] > lm_stats[4], "SPATIAL LAG", "SPATIAL ERROR"), "\n")

{r lm-tests}
# Use as.numeric() to strip names AND coerce to plain scalar before combining.
# [[1]] alone still carries the name attribute, which breaks round() in some
# R versions when passed inside c() into data.frame().
lm_stats <- as.numeric(c(lm_tests$LMlag$statistic,  lm_tests$LMerr$statistic,
                          lm_tests$RLMlag$statistic, lm_tests$RLMerr$statistic))
lm_df_s  <- as.numeric(c(lm_tests$LMlag$parameter,  lm_tests$LMerr$parameter,
                          lm_tests$RLMlag$parameter, lm_tests$RLMerr$parameter))
lm_pvals <- as.numeric(c(lm_tests$LMlag$p.value,    lm_tests$LMerr$p.value,
                          lm_tests$RLMlag$p.value,   lm_tests$RLMerr$p.value))

preferred_row <- ifelse(lm_stats[3] > lm_stats[4], 3L, 4L)


```{r lm-tests}
# Extract with correct names
lm_stats <- as.numeric(c(
  lm_tests$RSlag$statistic, 
  lm_tests$RSerr$statistic,
  lm_tests$adjRSlag$statistic, 
  lm_tests$adjRSerr$statistic
))

lm_df_s <- as.numeric(c(
  lm_tests$RSlag$parameter, 
  lm_tests$RSerr$parameter,
  lm_tests$adjRSlag$parameter, 
  lm_tests$adjRSerr$parameter
))

lm_pvals <- as.numeric(c(
  lm_tests$RSlag$p.value, 
  lm_tests$RSerr$p.value,
  lm_tests$adjRSlag$p.value, 
  lm_tests$adjRSerr$p.value
))

# Determine preferred model (using robust statistics: adjRSlag vs adjRSerr)
preferred_row <- ifelse(lm_stats[3] > lm_stats[4], 3L, 4L)

# Create data frame
lm_df <- data.frame(
  Test = c("RSlag (standard)", "RSerr (standard)",
           "adjRSlag (robust)", "adjRSerr (robust)"),
  Statistic = round(lm_stats, 3),
  df = lm_df_s,
  p_value = formatC(lm_pvals, format = "e", digits = 3),
  Decision = c("—", "—", "—", "—"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Mark preferred model
lm_df$Decision[preferred_row] <- "← Preferred"

# Create and style table
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

kable(lm_df,
      col.names = c("Test", "Statistic", "df", "p-value", "Selection"),
      caption = "Supplementary Table 1. Lagrange Multiplier Diagnostic Tests") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(preferred_row, bold = TRUE, background = "#EEF4FB")

# Print decision
cat("\nDecision rule: When both robust statistics are significant,\n")
cat("select the model with the LARGER robust statistic.\n")
cat("adjRSlag (robust):", round(lm_stats[3], 2),
    " | adjRSerr (robust):", round(lm_stats[4], 2), "\n")
cat("\u2192 Preferred model:",
    ifelse(lm_stats[3] > lm_stats[4], "SPATIAL LAG", "SPATIAL ERROR"), "\n")
```

## Step 7 — Moran's I on Spatial Model Residuals

```{r moran-spatial-residuals}
moran_lag_resid <- moran.test(
  residuals(spatial_lag), lw_reg, zero.policy = TRUE
)
moran_err_resid <- moran.test(
  residuals(spatial_err), lw_reg, zero.policy = TRUE
)

cat("=== Moran's I: Spatial Lag Residuals ===\n")
print(moran_lag_resid)

cat("\n=== Moran's I: Spatial Error Residuals ===\n")
print(moran_err_resid)

# Add to the summary table built below
morans_resid_table <- tibble(
  Model                = c("OLS Adjusted", "Spatial Lag", "Spatial Error"),
  `Moran's I`          = c(
    round(moran_ols_resid$estimate[1],  3),
    round(moran_lag_resid$estimate[1],  3),
    round(moran_err_resid$estimate[1],  3)
  ),
  `Z-score`            = c(
    round(moran_ols_resid$statistic,  2),
    round(moran_lag_resid$statistic,  2),
    round(moran_err_resid$statistic,  2)
  ),
  `p-value`            = c(
    formatC(moran_ols_resid$p.value,  format = "e", digits = 3),
    formatC(moran_lag_resid$p.value,  format = "e", digits = 3),
    formatC(moran_err_resid$p.value,  format = "e", digits = 3)
  ),
  `Autocorrelation resolved?` = c("No", "Yes", "Yes")
)

kable(morans_resid_table,
      caption = "Supplementary Table 2. Moran's I on Model Residuals") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(1, background = "#FFEEEE") %>%
  row_spec(2:3, background = "#EEFFEE")
```

# Phase 8: Full Model Comparison Table (Publication-Ready)

```{r model-comparison-table}
# ── Extract coefficients with SE and 95% CI ──────────────────────────────────

# OLS Unadjusted
ols_u_summ  <- summary(ols_unadj)$coefficients
ols_u_ci    <- confint(ols_unadj)

# OLS Adjusted
ols_a_summ  <- summary(ols_adj)$coefficients
ols_a_ci    <- confint(ols_adj)

# Spatial Lag — extract from spatialreg summary
sl_summ     <- summary(spatial_lag)
sl_coef     <- sl_summ$Coef            # named matrix: Estimate, Std.Error, z-value, p-value
sl_ci       <- sl_coef[, "Estimate"] + outer(sl_coef[, "Std. Error"],
                                              c(lower = -1.96, upper = 1.96))
# Spatial Error
se_summ     <- summary(spatial_err)
se_coef     <- se_summ$Coef
se_ci       <- se_coef[, "Estimate"] + outer(se_coef[, "Std. Error"],
                                              c(lower = -1.96, upper = 1.96))

# ── Helper: format a cell as "estimate (SE) [CI_low, CI_high] sig" ───────────
fmt_cell <- function(est, se, ci_l, ci_u, pval) {
  sig <- dplyr::case_when(
    pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
    pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
    pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
    pval < 0.10  ~ "†",
    TRUE         ~ ""
  )
  sprintf("%.3f%s\n(SE %.3f)\n[%.3f, %.3f]",
          est, sig, se, ci_l, ci_u)
}

# ── Build rows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vars <- c("pm25", "poverty_pct", "pct_nhblack", "uninsured_pct",
          "med_income", "pop_density")

var_labels <- c(
  "pm25"          = "PM2.5 (β per µg/m³)",
  "poverty_pct"   = "Poverty Rate (%)",
  "pct_nhblack"   = "% Non-Hispanic Black",
  "uninsured_pct" = "Uninsured Rate (%)",
  "med_income"    = "Median Income ($)",
  "pop_density"   = "Population Density"
)

build_row <- function(varname) {
  label <- var_labels[varname]

  # Unadjusted OLS (only pm25 row)
  if (varname == "pm25") {
    col1 <- fmt_cell(
      ols_u_summ[varname, "Estimate"],
      ols_u_summ[varname, "Std. Error"],
      ols_u_ci[varname, 1], ols_u_ci[varname, 2],
      ols_u_summ[varname, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  } else {
    col1 <- "—"
  }

  # Adjusted OLS
  col2 <- fmt_cell(
    ols_a_summ[varname, "Estimate"],
    ols_a_summ[varname, "Std. Error"],
    ols_a_ci[varname, 1], ols_a_ci[varname, 2],
    ols_a_summ[varname, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )

  # Spatial Lag
  if (varname %in% rownames(sl_coef)) {
    col3 <- fmt_cell(
      sl_coef[varname, "Estimate"],
      sl_coef[varname, "Std. Error"],
      sl_ci[varname, "lower"],
      sl_ci[varname, "upper"],
      sl_coef[varname, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  } else { col3 <- "—" }

  # Spatial Error
  if (varname %in% rownames(se_coef)) {
    col4 <- fmt_cell(
      se_coef[varname, "Estimate"],
      se_coef[varname, "Std. Error"],
      se_ci[varname, "lower"],
      se_ci[varname, "upper"],
      se_coef[varname, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  } else { col4 <- "—" }

  tibble(Variable = label,
         `Unadj. OLS` = col1,
         `Adj. OLS`   = col2,
         `Spatial Lag` = col3,
         `Spatial Error` = col4)
}

coef_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(vars, build_row)

# ── Spatial parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rho_row <- tibble(
  Variable       = "Spatial ρ (rho)",
  `Unadj. OLS`   = "—",
  `Adj. OLS`     = "—",
  `Spatial Lag`  = fmt_cell(
    as.numeric(sl_summ$rho),
    as.numeric(sl_summ$rho.se),
    as.numeric(sl_summ$rho) - 1.96 * as.numeric(sl_summ$rho.se),
    as.numeric(sl_summ$rho) + 1.96 * as.numeric(sl_summ$rho.se),
    as.numeric(sl_summ$LR1$p.value[1])
  ),
  `Spatial Error` = "—"
)

lambda_row <- tibble(
  Variable        = "Spatial λ (lambda)",
  `Unadj. OLS`    = "—",
  `Adj. OLS`      = "—",
  `Spatial Lag`   = "—",
  `Spatial Error` = fmt_cell(
    as.numeric(se_summ$lambda),
    as.numeric(se_summ$lambda.se),
    as.numeric(se_summ$lambda) - 1.96 * as.numeric(se_summ$lambda.se),
    as.numeric(se_summ$lambda) + 1.96 * as.numeric(se_summ$lambda.se),
    as.numeric(se_summ$LR1$p.value[1])
  )
)

# ── Model fit rows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_unadj <- summary(ols_unadj)$r.squared
r2_adj   <- summary(ols_adj)$r.squared

fit_rows <- tibble(
  Variable = c("R² / Pseudo-R²", "Log-likelihood", "AIC",
               "Moran's I (residuals)"),
  `Unadj. OLS`    = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", r2_unadj),
    sprintf("%.1f", as.numeric(logLik(ols_unadj))),
    sprintf("%.1f", AIC(ols_unadj)),
    sprintf("%.3f***", moran_ols_resid$estimate[1])
  ),
  `Adj. OLS`      = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", r2_adj),
    sprintf("%.1f", as.numeric(logLik(ols_adj))),
    sprintf("%.1f", AIC(ols_adj)),
    sprintf("%.3f***", moran_ols_resid$estimate[1])
  ),
  `Spatial Lag`   = c(
    "—",
    sprintf("%.1f", as.numeric(logLik(spatial_lag))),
    sprintf("%.1f", AIC(spatial_lag)),
    sprintf("%.3f (ns)", moran_lag_resid$estimate[1])
  ),
  `Spatial Error` = c(
    "—",
    sprintf("%.1f", as.numeric(logLik(spatial_err))),
    sprintf("%.1f", AIC(spatial_err)),
    sprintf("%.3f (ns)", moran_err_resid$estimate[1])
  )
)

# ── Combine and display ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
full_table <- bind_rows(coef_rows, rho_row, lambda_row, fit_rows)

kable(
  full_table,
  caption = "Table 4. Regression Models: PM2.5 and Adult Asthma ED Visit Rates",
  align   = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = 12
  ) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#EEF4FB") %>%
  row_spec(nrow(full_table) - 3, extra_css = "border-top: 2px solid #1F4E79;") %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "*** p < 0.001; ** p < 0.01; * p < 0.05; † p < 0.10; ns = not significant; — = not applicable.\n",
      "Format: Estimate*** (SE) [95% CI lower, upper].\n",
      "Spatial models estimated by maximum likelihood. 95% CI computed as Estimate ± 1.96 × SE.\n",
      "Outcome: sex-averaged adult asthma ED visit rate per 10,000 (variable 'asthma_female').\n",
      "n (regression sample) = ", nrow(analysis_reg), " counties (28 EPHT-reporting states)."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```

# Phase 9: Sensitivity Analyses

## Sensitivity 1 — Rook vs. Queen Contiguity

```{r sensitivity-rook}
# Rook contiguity (shared edges only, no corners)
nb_rook <- poly2nb(analysis_reg, queen = FALSE)
lw_rook <- nb2listw(nb_rook, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

spatial_lag_rook <- lagsarlm(
  asthma_female ~ pm25 + poverty_pct + pct_nhblack +
                  uninsured_pct + med_income + pop_density,
  data        = analysis_reg,
  listw       = lw_rook,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

sl_rook_summ <- summary(spatial_lag_rook)

cat("=== Sensitivity: Rook Contiguity — Spatial Lag ===\n")
cat("PM2.5 coefficient (rook):",
    round(sl_rook_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 4),
    " | p:", round(sl_rook_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4), "\n")
cat("Rho (rook):",
    round(sl_rook_summ$rho, 4), "\n")
cat("AIC (rook):", AIC(spatial_lag_rook), "\n")
cat("AIC (queen):", AIC(spatial_lag), "\n")

# Comparison
sens1 <- tibble(
  Weights       = c("Queen (primary)", "Rook (sensitivity)"),
  `PM2.5 β`     = c(round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 4),
                     round(sl_rook_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 4)),
  `PM2.5 p`     = c(round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4),
                     round(sl_rook_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4)),
  `ρ`           = c(round(sl_summ$rho, 4), round(sl_rook_summ$rho, 4)),
  `AIC`         = c(round(AIC(spatial_lag), 1), round(AIC(spatial_lag_rook), 1))
)

kable(sens1,
      caption = "Supplementary Table 3. Sensitivity: Queen vs. Rook Contiguity") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Sensitivity 2 — Exclude Wildfire-Affected Western States

```{r sensitivity-wildfire}
# Exclude states with high wildfire PM2.5 contribution
# (CA, OR, WA, MT, ID, NV, AZ, NM, CO, WY, UT)
wildfire_states <- c("06","41","53","30","16","32","04","35","08","56","49")

analysis_reg_nowf <- analysis_reg %>%
  filter(!STATEFP %in% wildfire_states)

cat("Regression sample excluding wildfire states:",
    nrow(analysis_reg_nowf), "counties\n")

nb_nowf <- poly2nb(analysis_reg_nowf, queen = TRUE)
lw_nowf <- nb2listw(nb_nowf, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

spatial_lag_nowf <- lagsarlm(
  asthma_female ~ pm25 + poverty_pct + pct_nhblack +
                  uninsured_pct + med_income + pop_density,
  data        = analysis_reg_nowf,
  listw       = lw_nowf,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

sl_nowf_summ <- summary(spatial_lag_nowf)

sens2 <- tibble(
  Sample             = c("Full sample (primary)", "Excl. wildfire states"),
  n                  = c(nrow(analysis_reg), nrow(analysis_reg_nowf)),
  `PM2.5 β`          = c(round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 4),
                          round(sl_nowf_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 4)),
  `PM2.5 p`          = c(round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4),
                          round(sl_nowf_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4)),
  `ρ`                = c(round(sl_summ$rho, 4), round(sl_nowf_summ$rho, 4)),
  `AIC`              = c(round(AIC(spatial_lag), 1),
                         round(AIC(spatial_lag_nowf), 1))
)

kable(sens2,
      caption = "Supplementary Table 4. Sensitivity: Exclusion of Wildfire-Affected Western States") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

cat("\nPM2.5 coefficient change:",
    round(sl_nowf_summ$Coef["pm25","Estimate"] -
          sl_summ$Coef["pm25","Estimate"], 4), "\n")
```

## Sensitivity 3 — LISA at Alternative Significance Thresholds

```{r sensitivity-lisa-thresholds}
# Re-classify at p < 0.01 and p < 0.001 (NA guard: counties without asthma data)
analysis_sf_esda <- analysis_sf_esda %>%
  mutate(
    lisa_cluster_01 = case_when(
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.01 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "High-High",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.01 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.01 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "High-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.01 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "Low-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    lisa_cluster_001 = case_when(
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.001 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "High-High",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.001 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.001 & asthma_std > 0 & lag_asthma_std < 0 ~ "High-Low",
      !is.na(lisa_pval) & lisa_pval < 0.001 & asthma_std < 0 & lag_asthma_std > 0 ~ "Low-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

# Count HH and LL at each threshold
thresh_table <- tibble(
  Threshold = c("p < 0.05 (primary)", "p < 0.01", "p < 0.001"),
  `High-High (n)` = c(
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster    == "High-High"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_01 == "High-High"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_001== "High-High")
  ),
  `Low-Low (n)` = c(
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster    == "Low-Low"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_01 == "Low-Low"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_001== "Low-Low")
  ),
  `High-Low (n)` = c(
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster    == "High-Low"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_01 == "High-Low"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_001== "High-Low")
  ),
  `Low-High (n)` = c(
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster    == "Low-High"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_01 == "Low-High"),
    sum(analysis_sf_esda$lisa_cluster_001== "Low-High")
  )
)

kable(thresh_table,
      caption = "Supplementary Table 5. LISA Cluster Stability Across Significance Thresholds") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
```

# Phase 10: Final Summary Output

## Moran's I Full Summary Table

```{r moran-summary}
moran_full <- tibble(
  Variable                     = c("PM2.5 Concentration",
                                   "Asthma ED Visit Rate (sex-avg)",
                                   "OLS Adjusted Residuals",
                                   "Spatial Lag Residuals",
                                   "Spatial Error Residuals"),
  `Moran's I`                  = c(
    round(moran_pm25$estimate[1],       3),
    round(moran_asthma$estimate[1],     3),
    round(moran_ols_resid$estimate[1],  3),
    round(moran_lag_resid$estimate[1],  3),
    round(moran_err_resid$estimate[1],  3)
  ),
  `Z-score`                    = c(
    round(moran_pm25$statistic,       2),
    round(moran_asthma$statistic,     2),
    round(moran_ols_resid$statistic,  2),
    round(moran_lag_resid$statistic,  2),
    round(moran_err_resid$statistic,  2)
  ),
  `p-value`                    = c(
    "< 2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶",
    "< 2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶",
    "< 2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶",
    formatC(moran_lag_resid$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3),
    formatC(moran_err_resid$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3)
  ),
  `Spatial autocorrelation`    = c("Yes", "Yes", "Yes — model inadequate",
                                   "No — resolved", "No — resolved")
)

kable(moran_full,
      caption = "Table 2 (complete). Global Moran's I — All Variables and Residuals") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(3, background = "#FFEEEE") %>%
  row_spec(4:5, background = "#EEFFEE")
```

```{r manuscript-numbers}
    "| AIC:", round(AIC(ols_adj), 1), "\n\n")

cat("--- Spatial Lag Model ---\n")
cat("PM2.5 β:", round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 3),
    "| SE:", round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Std. Error"], 3),
    "| 95% CI: [",
    round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25","Estimate"] - 1.96*sl_summ$Coef["pm25","Std. Error"], 3), ",",
    round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25","Estimate"] + 1.96*sl_summ$Coef["pm25","Std. Error"], 3), "]\n")
cat("PM2.5 p:", round(sl_summ$Coef["pm25", "Pr(>|z|)"], 4), "\n")
cat("Rho (ρ):", round(sl_summ$rho, 3),
    "| SE:", round(sl_summ$rho.se, 3), "\n")
cat("AIC    :", round(AIC(spatial_lag), 1), "\n\n")

cat("--- Spatial Error Model ---\n")
cat("PM2.5 β:", round(se_summ$Coef["pm25", "Estimate"], 3),
    "| SE:", round(se_summ$Coef["pm25", "Std. Error"], 3), "\n")
cat("Lambda (λ):", round(se_summ$lambda, 3),
    "| SE:", round(se_summ$lambda.se, 3), "\n")
cat("AIC    :", round(AIC(spatial_err), 1), "\n")

cat("\n================================================================\n")
cat("SESSION INFO\n")
cat("================================================================\n")
sessionInfo()
```
